name: Karen Maneater

features.name: Expanding reels
features.description: Scatters make the reels to their right taller.

review:
A satirical six-reel game that grows from three rows. Raccoon scatters land on the middle four reels, and each one makes every reel to its right one spot taller. Infectious xWays on the middle reels reveal and spread two to four symbols.

A wild on the last reel nudges to the bottom, gaining +1 per nudge. The growing grid is the main draw. Insane volatility, 11,757x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
